snippet.title: Kaidan - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744040/Kaidan/

Cosmic Horror twists dark fantasy Japan in a brutal, atmospheric, PvE extraction-lite experience.

Kaidan plunges you into a nightmarish vision of Japanese dark fantasy corrupted by unknowable cosmic horror. Face grotesque Yokai in intense PvE combat, alone or with friends. Endure a relentless descent into madness, where every moment is a vicious fight to survive
